title: adversarial_transcript external score
description: EXTERNAL base-verifier readout for one candidate, joined to candidates on (item_id, condition, candidate_idx). select.py is offline-first and consumes these directly; producing them (a heavy verifier pass) is handled by score_verifier.py. The internal score.py can emit a DRY-RUN placeholder of this shape.

qy_clean_pred_letter.description: base verifier's clean no-transcript Q_Y letter (A/B)

qy_clean_pred.description: semantic clean Q_Y prediction: Y_true or Y_false

qy_clean_correct.description: whether clean no-transcript Q_Y readout chose Y_true

qy_adv_pred.description: semantic transcript-conditioned Q_Y prediction: Y_true or Y_false

qy_adv_correct.description: whether transcript-conditioned Q_Y readout chose Y_true; THE Adv-BoK-Hfalse selection gate (absolute, not no-regression)

qy_adv_probs.description: {letter: {A, B}, semantic: {Y_true, Y_false}}. semantic.Y_true is the Q_Y-fallback ranking quantity used when no safe candidate passes the absolute gate; select.py never reconstructs it from 1 - Y_false, the letter block, or qy_adv_pred.

qy_no_regression_pass.description: LEGACY no-regression rule: qy_clean_correct is false OR qy_adv_correct is true. Retained as scorer provenance / diagnostics and still validated for internal consistency, but it is NO LONGER a selection gate.

qy_correct.description: deprecated alias for qy_adv_correct; not an independent compatibility path, since qy_adv_correct is required and a row lacking it is schema-invalid

p_hfalse.description: P_Vbase(H_false | Q_H, transcript): the CTI ranking quantity

qh_probs.description: full posterior over Q_H options, if available

baseline_p_hfalse.description: no-transcript prior, for the secondary readout
